verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion is a fair privacy question for any service that holds user data, including a government tax portal, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no documented user control over how long data is kept or how to delete it. Agents adding or deleting client enrollments and emailing a request to reverse E-Verify certification are different account-management features, not data-retention or deletion controls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
